verdict.rationale: As a compliance and security SaaS that holds customer data, Oneleet could plausibly offer retention and deletion controls, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no data-retention settings, retention windows, or user-initiated deletion of Oneleet-held data. The nearest items are adjacent behaviors that earn no credit here: framework removal pruning unused controls, deleting an AWS IAM role to revoke access (a host-platform action), and MDM remote device actions.
